meta.coordinates: S1 units, y grows downward; no scaling, no slant change (S1 slants about 22.5 degrees); S1 draws every stroke 1.0 wide
meta.shapeOnly: chains are continuous runs of S1 pieces; their order and direction carry no stroke order or pen direction
meta.subpathNumbering: each <path> element of the source in document order, split at each M, counted from 0; segment k is the k-th drawn piece of its subpath, a closing Z counting only when it draws
meta.smoothing: both handles turned to one common tangent, the turn split by arc length (piece a turns lb / (la + lb) of the angle, piece b la / (la + lb)); a long straight piece never moves and its neighbour takes the whole turn; nodes in a fixed order (chain by chain, along each chain, a closed chain's closing node last), and a node keeps its corner if smoothing it would move any piece more than the cap from its geometry after snaps, measured cumulatively; the run fails if any piece ends over the cap
